title: Run DRC and resolve all PCB layout violations

context_files.reason: Board outline specs: 40x65mm, 2-layer, 1.6mm FR4, 3mm radius corners

acceptance_criteria: Run: kicad-cli pcb drc --output drc.txt gos_sensor_node.kicad_pcb
DRC report shows 0 warnings (or only acceptable warnings documented)
Verify board outline: 40mm x 65mm, 1.6mm FR4, 3mm corner radius
Check: Minimum trace width ≥ 0.15mm (6mil) for signals, ≥ 0.3mm (12mil) for power
Check: Minimum via size 0.3mm drill, 0.5mm annular ring
Check: Power nets (VBUS, VSYS, VDD_3V3, VBATT) have adequate copper pour
Check: RF trace (ANT) impedance controlled (50Ω target)
Check: Crystal traces (Y1, Y2) kept short with guard rings
Check: Decoupling capacitors placed close to IC power pins
Check: Thermal vias under TPS62740, BQ24075, AL8860 packages
Check: Ground plane stitching vias throughout
